streaming_groups_per_shard.consequence: A generation-request parameter (part of the fingerprint, cannot change after generation): it belongs to DR-04 and is listed here only because it fixes the training window. 4 groups = 32 observations = 12.06 MiB raw float16 and 20.0 MiB preprocessed float32 (dual_residual); the 1,500 train groups are 375 shards.

streaming_window_shards.source: src/geoml/b2_stream.py:67 (DEFAULT_WINDOW_SHARDS=4, 'a declared engineering choice, not a tuned value'); src/geoml/b2_experiment.py:67; P24_b2_e1_streaming_loader.md:91-103

alternatives.note: 4 scenario groups per window: weakest batch diversity, smallest memory
doubles the window; steady window bytes scale linearly (128 MiB at 4 shards)
one window = the whole train role = uniform permutation like the legacy path, but 12.6 GB of float32 inputs plus plan-shift copy resident (analytic)

streaming_window_shards.consequence: BLOCKED SHUFFLE (P24 section 5): whole shards are permuted per epoch, samples are permuted inside a window, the 8 paired variants of a group always share a window, and a mini-batch can draw from at most window_shards x groups_per_shard = 16 scenario groups (4 x 4; 32 at 8 groups per shard), plus carried remainder rows only if the window size is not a multiple of the batch (128 and the final 96-observation window are multiples of 8 and 32, so none here). BatchNorm statistics and the augmentation RNG stream therefore differ from a uniform permutation. window_shards enters the experiment fingerprint. Analytic window memory at (4 groups, 4 shards): 128 MiB steady, 128.2 MiB while building; at (8 groups, 4 shards): 256 MiB.

A snapshot only pays if the real per-fit time is hours, which the DR-05 probe must establish first.

alternatives.note: replaces every assumed number in this record

expected_sample_passes_and_wall_clock.consequence: The 200-1000 samples/s band is an assumption stated for the width-8 model; width 16 has 3.3x the MACs. Separately, no prefetch or worker exists, so loader time adds to compute time: at E1 rates it is about 39 min per fit and 5.9 h for nine fits, which alone approaches the 6 GPU-h reservation (0.9-4.5 h compute + 5.9 h loader if not overlapped). The E1 rates were measured on a different, loaded CPU; the GPU host may be faster. This is why the probe must measure end to end.

researcher_decisions.title: Scope of fits: views and training seeds
researcher_decisions.sentence: R1: I approve training the views [co, dual, dual_residual | dual_residual only | ...] with the fixed training seeds [0, 1, 2] per view ([9 | 3 | ...] fits); all seeds are reported and none is selected by outcome.

researcher_decisions.title: Model width and input resolution
researcher_decisions.sentence: R2: I choose model width [8 | 16 | 32] and time_pool [2 | 1] with the per-sample carrier reference (level 'carrier').

researcher_decisions.title: K18 loss convention and weights (depends on R2)
researcher_decisions.sentence: R3: K18: I choose option [A | B | C | D]; centre-loss weight [..], plan-BCE weight [..]; add the train-only centre/CE diagnostic: [yes | no]. (Wording as in B2_E6_RESEARCHER_DECISION_PACKET.md section 6.)

researcher_decisions.title: Epoch budget and how it is fixed
researcher_decisions.sentence: R4: I fix the budget at [N] epochs for every fit (fixed-length OneCycle schedule, no early stopping); N is [taken unchanged from P6 | chosen by the pre-registered train/val-select sizing rule: ...] and no test, test-only, matched or val-calib result informs it.

researcher_decisions.title: Batch size
researcher_decisions.sentence: R5: I fix the batch size at [8 | 32 | ...].

researcher_decisions.title: Optimizer, schedule, clipping, augmentation (the P6 recipe)
researcher_decisions.sentence: R6: I approve AdamW (peak lr [1e-3], weight decay [1e-4] on all parameters including BatchNorm, biases and centres, torch default betas/eps) with OneCycleLR (torch defaults: pct_start 0.3, cosine, div_factor 25, final_div_factor 1e4, momentum cycling 0.85-0.95), no gradient clipping, fp32, mirror (p = 0.5) plus one circular time roll per batch, on the pinned torch version.

researcher_decisions.title: Streaming window and sample-order policy
researcher_decisions.sentence: R7: I accept the blocked-shuffle sample order with [4] groups per shard and [4] shards per window (at most [16] scenario groups per window) as the production training order.

researcher_decisions.title: Test-evaluation coupling
researcher_decisions.sentence: R8: I choose [procedural freeze of the 3 x 3 plan | a reviewed train-only mode before the source lock] to keep test evaluation after all fits are frozen.

researcher_decisions.title: Interruption policy
researcher_decisions.sentence: R9: an interrupted fit [restarts from epoch 0 with the parent checkpoint hash recorded | resumes from a reviewed snapshot implemented before long training].

not_decided_here: Approval of this proposal: every record's approval is null; nothing here is frozen, locked or registered in a config.
K18, K17d and OBS-CANCEL/2 (gates stay PENDING_RESEARCHER); full generation, full GPU training and the full LOKO sweep (stay NOT_AUTHORIZED).
GPU model, VRAM ceiling, host machine, the bounded throughput/VRAM probe and its caps (DR-05).
Resource ceilings for training (GPU-hours, wall time, disk): the 6 GPU-h reservation is an E5 planning figure, not an authorization.
Training recipe for the LOKO folds (same recipe or a reduced one) and the LOKO dispatcher / cross-seed aggregation (not implemented).
The cross-seed aggregation rule for reporting (P6: averaged; P18: seed uncertainty separate); only 'report per seed, bootstrap separately' is stated by the plan.
The tolerance and candidate list of any epoch-sizing rule (R4).
Which P18 section 8 ablation names the three views correspond to.
Whether the observation-only train-time diagnostics being added by another work package (center/CE ratio) are accepted: that is R3, not decided here.
Any change to configs/, protocol documents P18-P28, src/ or the gates file: this work package touched none of them.
